unavailable.title: Not available in your community
unavailable.body: Your community has not switched this feature on. If you would like it, ask your community team.

tools.heading: My volunteering tools
tools.description: Extra things you can do as a volunteer. Only the ones your community has switched on are shown.
tools.empty: Your community has not switched on any volunteer tools yet.
tools.waitlistsHint: See where you are in the queue for full shifts and claim a place when one frees up.
tools.alertsHint: Answer organisers who need someone for a shift at short notice.
tools.wellbeingHint: Check in on how volunteering is going for you.
tools.qualificationsHint: Keep a record of the training and certificates you hold.
tools.incidentHint: Tell your community safeguarding lead about something that worried you.
tools.accessibilityHint: Tell us what would make volunteering easier for you.
tools.groupSignupsHint: Reserve places on a shift for a group you run.

donations.cardBody: Card payments are made on our website. The button below opens it in your browser.
donations.cardLabel: Donate by card. Opens the website in your browser.

expenses.receiptHint: Optional. Add a photo of your receipt to help your organiser check the claim.
expenses.receiptTooLarge: That photo is too large. Please choose a smaller one.
expenses.receiptPickError: Could not add that photo. Please try again.

waitlist.title: Waiting lists
waitlist.intro: When a shift is full, you can join its waiting list. If a place frees up, you will be told and can claim it.
waitlist.empty: You are not on any waiting lists
waitlist.emptyHint: When a shift is full, you can join its waiting list from the opportunity page.
waitlist.loadError: Could not load your waiting lists.
waitlist.onList: You are on the waiting list (position {{position}})
waitlist.leaveConfirmMessage: You will lose your place in the queue. You can join again later if the shift is still full.
waitlist.leaveError: Could not leave the waiting list. Please try again.
waitlist.claimHint: A place has become free. Claim it soon, or it may be offered to the next person.
waitlist.claimedBody: You are now signed up for this shift.
waitlist.claimError: Could not claim this place. It may have been taken.
waitlist.joinedTitle: You are on the waiting list
waitlist.joinedBody: We will tell you if a place comes free. You can see your position under Waiting lists.
waitlist.joinError: Could not add you to the waiting list.
waitlist.leftTitle: You have left the waiting list

alerts.title: Urgent requests
alerts.intro: Organisers send these when a shift suddenly needs someone. Accept if you can help, or decline if you cannot.
alerts.loadError: Could not load your urgent requests.
alerts.declinedBody: Thanks for letting the organiser know.
alerts.respondError: Could not send your answer. Please try again.

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing
wellbeing.intro: A quick check on how volunteering is going for you. Your summary below is only for you.
wellbeing.loadError: Could not load your wellbeing summary.
wellbeing.lowScoreBody: Your recent volunteering has been heavy. It is fine to say no to a shift or take a few days off.
wellbeing.notePlaceholder: Anything you would like to say about how you are feeling
wellbeing.shareLabel: Let my community team know how I am feeling
wellbeing.shareOn: Staff can read your note after signing in. The organisations you volunteer with are told your name and how you feel, but never your note.
wellbeing.shareOff: Nobody else is told. Only you can see this check-in.
wellbeing.submitError: Could not record your check-in. Please try again.
wellbeing.teamNotified: Thank you for telling us. Someone from your community team will be in touch.
wellbeing.historyEmpty: You have not checked in yet.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: A record of the training and certificates you hold. Nothing is uploaded: you are only noting down the details.
qualifications.empty: You have not recorded any qualifications yet
qualifications.editConfirmedWarning: This qualification has been confirmed. If you change it, it will need to be confirmed again.
qualifications.expiresHint: Leave this empty if it does not expire.
qualifications.savedBody: Your community can confirm it once they have seen the original.
qualifications.saveError: Could not save this qualification. Please try again.
qualifications.titleRequired: Please give the qualification a name.
qualifications.dateInvalid: Enter dates as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-03-21.
qualifications.expiryBeforeObtained: The expiry date cannot be before the date obtained.
qualifications.withdrawError: Could not withdraw this qualification. Please try again.

reasons.replaced: It has been replaced by a newer one
reasons.volunteer_request: I no longer want it shown

incident.title: Report a concern
incident.intro: Tell your community safeguarding lead about something that worried you. They will look at it and decide what to do next.
incident.emergency: If someone is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now. This form is not watched around the clock.
incident.typeLabel: What kind of concern is it?
incident.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what you saw or were told.
incident.dateInvalid: Enter the date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-03-21.
incident.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
incident.optionsUnavailable: The list of organisations could not be loaded. You can still send your report.
incident.searchError: Could not search members. Please try again.
incident.required: Please fill in all the required fields.
incident.submitError: Could not send your report. Please try again.
incident.sentBody: Your reference is #{{id}}. Your community safeguarding lead will look at it.
incident.sentBodyNoId: Your community safeguarding lead will look at it.
incident.reportsEmpty: You have not sent any reports.

accessibility.title: Accessibility needs
accessibility.intro: Tell us what would make volunteering easier for you. You can add as many needs as you like.
accessibility.privacy: This is a private note for you. Organisations and coordinators cannot see it.
accessibility.loadError: Could not load your accessibility needs.
accessibility.empty: You have not added any needs
accessibility.duplicateType: You can only add each type of need once.
accessibility.savedBody: Your accessibility needs have been updated.
accessibility.saveError: Could not save your needs. Please try again.

code.title: My check-in code
code.intro: Show this code to your organiser when you arrive, and again when you leave.
code.loadError: Could not load your check-in code.
code.notYours: You are not signed up for this shift.
code.switchedOff: Your community has not switched on QR check-in.
